items.title: misaligned-half-points
items.claim: In 07-phone-result.png, the denominator of HasanAbi’s half-point fraction drops below the adjacent whole-number baseline in both the HUD and result score.
items.reason: The stacked digits make a single mixed score harder to read quickly.
items.suggest: Use a compact inline ½ glyph aligned with the whole number in both locations.

items.title: displaced-impact-streak
items.claim: In 11-phone-impact.png, white particles extend from above Asmongold’s head to his belt, while HasanAbi’s kicking foot meets his neck and shoulder.
items.reason: The effect obscures where the strike actually connects.
items.suggest: Center a compact particle burst at the foot’s contact point and shorten its vertical trails.

items.title: small-phone-labels
items.claim: At the stated 390×844 viewport, the visible letters in the fighter names and stick captions in 02-phone-fight.png are roughly 10–12 pixels tall.
items.reason: Players must read these labels while watching the fight on a small screen.
items.suggest: Set label fonts to at least 18 CSS pixels and help text to 20 pixels, adjusting spacing and wrapping.

items.title: inconsistent-combination-notation
items.claim: In 05-phone-techref.png, the header places “+” between Stance and Technique, but the move rows place “+” after both stick diagrams.
items.reason: The rows contradict the notation used to explain how commands combine.
items.suggest: Render each row as stance diagram, plus sign, technique diagram, then move name.

items.title: controls-outsize-fighters
items.claim: In 21-phone-kick-open.png, each joystick is approximately 168 CSS pixels across while each fighter is approximately 130 CSS pixels tall.
items.reason: The controls dominate the view while the smaller fighters make poses harder to distinguish.
items.suggest: Limit portrait camera zoom-out to keep fighters at least 170 CSS pixels tall while preserving the sticks’ touch areas.
